name: queencitycodefactory/app
description: Willetts Technology's Custom CakePHP skeleton app

suggest.cakephp/authentication: Official authentication plugin for CakePHP. Handles login, session, token, and OAuth-based authentication.
suggest.cakephp/authorization: Official authorization plugin for CakePHP. Policy-based access control for controllers and ORM queries.
suggest.cakephp/repl: Console tools for a REPL interface for CakePHP applications.
suggest.dereuromark/cakephp-expose: Exposes UUIDs instead of sequential IDs in URLs to prevent enumeration attacks.
suggest.dereuromark/cakephp-ide-helper: After baking your code, this keeps your annotations in sync with the code evolving from there on for maximum IDE and PHPStan/Psalm compatibility.
suggest.dereuromark/cakephp-queue: Database-backed job queue for CakePHP with a built-in admin panel.
suggest.markstory/asset_compress: An asset compression plugin which provides file concatenation and a flexible filter system for preprocessing and minification.
suggest.phpstan/phpstan: PHPStan focuses on finding errors in your code without actually running it. It catches whole classes of bugs even before you write tests for the code.
suggest.usemuffin/footprint: Automatically stamps created_by/modified_by fields on your entities from the logged-in user.
suggest.usemuffin/slug: Pluggable slug generation for CakePHP entities. Supports multiple strategies and custom finders.
suggest.usemuffin/trash: Soft-delete (trash) behavior for CakePHP. Adds trashable records with restore and purge support.
